mc-01-servo-autoridade.context: Mark starts fast, with no long introduction. After the baptism and the wilderness, Jesus announces in Galilee that the kingdom of God has come and calls fishermen to follow him.
mc-01-servo-autoridade.focusQuestion: What do you need to leave behind to answer Jesus' call today?
mc-01-servo-autoridade.keywordGloss: It is the good news of God announced by Jesus, which calls for repentance and faith.
facts: A voice from heaven calls Jesus the beloved Son.
The Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness.
After John was arrested, Jesus went to Galilee preaching.
Jesus announces that the kingdom of God is near.
Simon and Andrew left their nets and followed Jesus.

mc-02-caminho-cruz.context: Jesus openly teaches that the Son of Man will suffer, die, and rise. Peter does not accept this path, and Jesus then calls the crowd to follow him by taking up the cross.
mc-02-caminho-cruz.focusQuestion: What do you need to let go of to follow Jesus without reservation?
mc-02-caminho-cruz.keywordGloss: In Jesus' teaching, taking up the cross is denying yourself and following him, even at a cost.
facts: Jesus teaches that the Son of Man would suffer many things.
Peter took Jesus aside and began to rebuke him.
Jesus rebuked Peter in front of the disciples.
Jesus asks us to deny ourselves, take up the cross, and follow him.
Whoever loses their life for Jesus and the gospel will save it.

mc-03-cruz-ressurreicao.context: Women who followed Jesus go to the tomb on the first day of the week. On the way, they worry about the huge stone that seals the tomb's entrance.
mc-03-cruz-ressurreicao.focusQuestion: In front of what impossible stone do you need to hear again that Jesus has risen?
mc-03-cruz-ressurreicao.keywordGloss: It is the young man's announcement in the tomb: Jesus, the crucified one, lives and is no longer there.
facts: The women were asking who would roll away the stone from the tomb.
When they looked, they saw the stone had already been rolled away.
In the tomb, they saw a young man seated on the right, dressed in white.
The young man announces that Jesus has risen and is not here.
The message is to be given to the disciples and to Peter.

mc-boss-revisao.context: This challenge reviews all of Mark: the kingdom announced in Galilee, the way of the cross taught by Jesus, and the empty tomb that announces his victory over death.
mc-boss-revisao.focusQuestion: What does Jesus' path, from the announcement to the resurrection, ask of you today?
mc-boss-revisao.keywordGloss: In Mark, Jesus is the Son who serves, takes the path of the cross, and conquers death.
facts: Jesus announces that the kingdom of God is near.
Simon and Andrew left their nets and followed Jesus.
Jesus teaches that the Son of Man would rise after three days.
Jesus asks us to deny ourselves, take up the cross, and follow him.
The young man announces that Jesus has risen and is not here.
The message is to be given to the disciples and to Peter.
